title: Franny and Zooey
author: J. D. Salinger
summary: Two linked pieces about the gifted Glass siblings: Franny, a college student unravelling in a spiritual crisis, and her brother Zooey, who tries to talk her round in the family apartment.
readIf: you like dialogue-heavy novels about intelligent people searching for meaning.
skipIf: you want action or find long, talky scenes tiring.
